name: ApexTrade Tradier Model Context Protocol Integration
description: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration connecting ApexTrade to Tradier's hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.tradier.com/mcp) with Gemini API context.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieve user profile, account authorization status, and linked accounts from Tradier hosted MCP server.

tools.name: get_account_balances
tools.description: Verify sandbox account cash balances, buying power, total equity, and the $50 safety buffer for Tradier paper account 6YC17358.

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Fetch real-time quotes, bid-ask prices, and spread percentage for target tickers INTC, AMD, and F to check that (Ask - Bid) / Bid < 0.01.

tools.name: place_equity_order
tools.description: Route a market equity order via Tradier Smart Order Router with micro-lot sizing (1 to 3 shares) for account 6YC17358 and reconcile to apextrade.db.

quantity.description: Number of shares (1 to 3 shares max per micro-lot risk control)

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: Check order execution statuses (filled, rejected, open) and history for account 6YC17358.

limit.description: Number of recent orders to inspect
